sources.note: Main homepage. Describes MEDHOST as 40+ year partner to community hospitals with integrated EHR, EDIS, revenue cycle, and patient engagement solutions. 95% customer satisfaction score.
Lists four certified product lines: Business Intelligence, Enterprise (Clinicals and Financials), EDIS, and Cloud Services Health Portal. Links to certification details.
Details on Enterprise certifications. Shows separate Clinicals and Financials products. Lists additional software dependencies including Wolters Kluwer, Medispan, Microsoft SQL Server.

EHR overview page. Describes clinical suite, revenue cycle suite, continuity of care (YourCare), patient engagement, mobile solutions, and interoperability features including CCDA 2.1, Direct Messaging, Surescripts, FHIR APIs.

Clinical suite overview. Lists EDIS, Perioperative Experience, Clinician Experience (Patient Care Documentation, eMAR, Care Plan), Physician Experience, Anesthesia Experience, and Pharmacy Experience modules.
Details on Lab/Radiology/Pharmacy information systems, Documentation Management System (DMS), Patient Care Documentation, and eMAR with Five Rights enforcement.
Perioperative module details — full surgical workflow from scheduling through post-op surveys, digital patient tracking displays replacing whiteboards.

EDIS details — patient tracking, CPOE, nurse charting, physician documentation, Toolkit admin, reporting, graphical floor plans, touch-screen design, barcode scanning, closed-loop medication admin, charge capture, ED Online Check-In.

Revenue cycle and financials overview. Includes revenue cycle solutions, patient access solutions, general financials (AP, credit card, GL, materials management, time & attendance, document management), business services, HIM Worklist.
YourCare Continuum suite — care coordination portal for scheduling, referrals, order sharing. YourCare Management for condition management (diabetic care).
Patient engagement suite — YourCare Everywhere (wellness app, mobile), YourCare Marketing (digital marketing), Price Transparency Solution.
Wikipedia article confirming founding in 1984, Franklin TN headquarters, Harris Computer acquisition in 2024.
January 2024 acquisition announcement. Harris Computer (Constellation Software subsidiary) acquired MEDHOST and MEDTEAM Solutions.
NRHA Services Corporation partner page. Describes MEDHOST as providing EHR, EDIS, pharmacy, perioperative, and business management solutions for rural hospitals.
Capterra EDIS reviews — 4.1/5 from 12 reviews. Praised for ER patient tracking and simplicity; criticized for dated UI and limited customization.
G2 reviews — 3.5/5 from 6 reviews. Mixed feedback on training ease vs. registration frustrations.
TrustRadius — 6.1/10 from 2 reviews. Moderate satisfaction, praise for configurability.
SelectHub overview with pricing and feature comparison. Notes subscription-based pricing without hidden fees.
SoftwareFinder profile. Strong for documentation and reporting, lower marks on issue resolution and integrations.
